title: Research Analysts’ Price Target Changes for January, 28th (AAPL, BEI, BIDU, BN, COK, HEN3, HK, IBKC, KER, NESN)
text:
Research Analysts’ price target changes for Monday, January 28th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $185.00 target price by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Beiersdorf (ETR:BEI) was given a €90.00 ($104.65) target price by analysts at Jefferies Financial Group Inc. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Baidu (NASDAQ:BIDU) had its target price reduced by Oppenheimer Holdings Inc. from $230.00 to $210.00. They currently have an outperform rating on the stock.
Danone (EPA:BN) was given a €68.00 ($79.07) target price by analysts at Jefferies Financial Group Inc. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Cancom (ETR:COK) was given a €40.00 ($46.51) price target by analysts at Warburg Research. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Henkel AG & Co KGaA (FRA:HEN3) was given a €96.00 ($111.63) target price by analysts at Jefferies Financial Group Inc. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Halcon Resources (NYSE:HK) had its target price reduced by Roth Capital from $13.00 to $3.50. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
IBERIABANK (NASDAQ:IBKC) had its price target boosted by Stephens from $85.00 to $91.00. They currently have an overweight rating on the stock.
Kering (EPA:KER) was given a €555.00 ($645.35) target price by analysts at Berenberg Bank. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Nestlé (VTX:NESN) was given a CHF 98 price target by analysts at Jefferies Financial Group Inc. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Roche Holding Ltd. Genussscheine (VTX:ROG) was given a CHF 265 target price by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
RWE (FRA:RWE) was given a €21.00 ($24.42) target price by analysts at HSBC Holdings plc. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Unilever (AMS:UNIA) was given a €51.00 ($59.30) price target by analysts at Jefferies Financial Group Inc. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
